transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we discuss the spring internship placement, I want to make sure we're aligned on the district's approval requirements. Our policy requires documented confirmation of four things before I can approve any internship plan: transportation, health-safety needs, student support requirements, and host-site supervision. Looking at the current draft, I have some concerns. The plan places the student at Site A on Tuesday and Thursday, but I don't see any documented confirmation of how the student will get to and from the site. On health-safety, the plan mentions standard disposable gloves, but I need to see a fuller documentation of health-safety needs. Regarding student support, the plan currently provides no job coach during the first week -- I need to understand whether that's appropriate or whether support requirements have been properly assessed. And finally, I don't see specifics on host-site supervision. I'd like to go through each of these areas before I can make a final approval decision.
